limitations.note: The agent fixed the shift direction but also changed the registered comparison to use the newly shifted value, moving the match pulse one clock earlier and causing the grading mismatches.
The test checked against history after shifting, so it confirmed the agent's same-cycle assumption rather than checking that match still reflected the pre-edge register value.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: Bundling the edit and simulation with a prohibited cleanup command caused the entire invocation to be rejected before either could run.
The replacement test runner relied on an unavailable Python executable, so the agent had to submit the testbench again in a shell-only command.
